examples.english: Friendship and these good neighbors are our treasures.
examples.transliteration: El sadaqa wel giran el 7elwin dol kenozna.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: ديما، كل الجيران بيحبوا أولادنا وبيقولوا إنهم أحسن أصحاب في الحي بتاعنا.
examples.english: Always, all the neighbors love our children and say that they are the best friends in our neighborhood.
examples.transliteration: Dayman, kol el giran bey7ebbu awladna w bey2oolo ennohom a7san as7ab fel 7ayy beta3na.

examples.arabic: العيال الصغيرين نطوا في الشارع والجيران فتحوا شبابيكهم.
examples.english: The small children jumped in the street and the neighbors opened their windows.
examples.transliteration: El eyal el soghayarin nato fel share' wel geran fataho shababikhom.
